missing_evidence: default value for mandatory session_id when omitted by caller
transformation rule to reconstruct nested file_status and dropped conflict metadata
candidate.reason: Adapting collab_check to collab_claim requires nested response structures (file_status.safe and file_status.blocked) and array mapping/grouping of conflicts with fields that were dropped (session IDs, scope, started_at), which cannot be expressed with flat ConstructResponse. Furthermore, collab_claim makes session_id required whereas collab_check had it as optional without a documented constant default.
candidate.risk: Callers omitting session_id will encounter parameter validation failures, and downstream consumers expecting nested file_status and rich conflict information will experience breaking runtime type and property access errors.
